title: Barn
description: Kenney-style red gambrel barn (BARN in src/defs/buildings.js): white trim, dark stepped-shingle roof, front cross-gable with hay-loft door and hay-hood beam, double swing doors hinged at the jambs, 16 straw stalls with dividers and header beams, two lanterns and hay bales inside. Cutaway nodes: roof, walls/wall_*, door_L/door_R.
checks: FRONT tile: a red barn with a double door centred in the long front wall, white frame round the doors and white X bracing on both leaves
FRONT tile: a small cross-gable sits above the doors with a white-framed hay-loft door and a beam sticking out at its peak
LEFT tile: the side wall's gable end shows the gambrel profile (steep lower slope, shallow upper slope) with white rake trim and a small window
3/4 tile: the dark grey roof shows stepped shingle rows and overhangs the walls; white corner boards and eave band are visible
3/4 tile: side walls have small square white-framed windows
LEFT tile: walls touch the grid line; nothing floats
no-roof TOP view: 8 straw stalls along the back wall and 4+4 along the front either side of the door, with wood dividers and cream header beams, the aisle between them clear in the middle
no-roof TOP view: two lanterns hang over the aisle at about x = +-3.8, hay bales stand at both aisle ends
far view: reads as a classic red barn with a dark roof, not a blob
